findings.title: Date rollover alone permits retry of unrelated failed case
findings.impact: Audit top-level PASS can replace an unrelated first failed status merely because date changed; first attempt remains nested and in log.
findings.recommendation: Retry only a proven fixture-date invalidation; preserve unrelated FAIL/COUNTEREXAMPLE/unknown INCOMPLETE for review. Do not alter business assertions.
retest: ASF10/11 run one attempt and keep first failed result
ASF09 legitimate originally-PASS invalidation can retry
Review affected prior rollover evidence without blanket invalidation of no-rollover runs
